categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: Points you can Teeleport to directly, so long as you're already in this Layer as a whole. A few are also Transition points.

categories.title: Chip Exchange
categories.info:
Exchange Banadium Chips for Banandium Gems, starting at 10 Chips and increasing by 10 for every purchase.

Note that the first Gem purchased on each layer is the only one that will count towards your collection.

categories.title: Getaway
categories.info: Speak to the Architectone to exchange gold for a getaway. Each one comes with a bed to restore health, closet for changing clothes, and gramophone to play music discs.

categories.title: Style Shop
categories.info: Style Shops let you buy and upgrade cosmetic items using the local Fossils in that layer.

categories.title: Banandium Gem
categories.info: Collecting 5 Banandium Gems allow you to upgrade DK's abilities through Skill Points.

categories.title: Clothing
categories.info: Clothing can be purchased (and sometimes upgraded) at Style Shops for fossils. They grant a wide variety of gameplay benefits.

categories.title: Fossil
categories.info: Common Fossils are used to buy the lowest-grade cosmetics at Style Shops, as well as buy their first upgrade.

categories.title: Shifty Smash
categories.info: Shifty Smash Challenges begin by punching the triangular pyramid, which will spawn one or several Shifty Blocks in the area. Destroy them all within the time limit to complete the challenge.

locations.title: 01 - Top of the Heap
locations.description: **Location:** On top of a large stone banana looming over the starting point.

locations.title: 02 - Freed the Blusterwing!
locations.description: **Location:** Buried in front of the arrival point to the layer.

locations.title: 03 - Bloomed in the Landfill Layer
locations.description: **Location:** Buried deep in the middle of the dirt. Clear out enough dirt so the sunlight touches the pot to grow the gem.

locations.title: 04 - Mazy-Cave Balloons
05 - Mazy-Cave Hidden Room
locations.description: **Location:** [Mazy Cave: Pop Party](#loc=477403) - Hidden behind a concrete wall, towards the back of the maze.

locations.title: 06 - Mazy-Cave Buried Banana
locations.description: **Location:** [Mazy Cave: Pop Party](#loc=477403) - After breaking the dirt wall, continue down until the end of the hallway. Then, dig down and move under the top wall to reveal the gem.

locations.title: 07 - Buried in Rubble
locations.description: **Location:** From [Middle Pit](#loc=477408), dig down through the junk face to reveal the gem surrounded by exploding rocks. Dig to it and trigger the explosions to clear the dirt and access the gem.

locations.title: 08 - Up and Down, Underground
locations.description: **Location:** From [Middle Pit](#loc=477408), dig down through the junk face to reveal the gem underneath a moving platform. Wait until it's at its top to access the gem.

locations.title: 09 - Shifty Smash: Dig Deep
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash](#loc=477411)

locations.title: 10 - Sniffing out a Secret
locations.description: **Location:** [Elephant Bananza: City Smash](#loc=477407) - On the top the entrance gate, underneath a concrete slab. Jump Shot to access, then use any block capable of destroying concrete to reveal the gem.

locations.title: 11 - Wrecked by Elephant Bananza
locations.description: **Location:** [Elephant Bananza: City Smash](#loc=477407) - Destroy the entire building within the 60 second time limit.

locations.title: 12 - Quickly with Elephant Bananza
locations.description: **Location:** [Elephant Bananza: City Smash](#loc=477407) - Destroy the building under 40 seconds.

locations.title: 13 - Battle: Search and Destroy
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Landfill Layer Battle Challenge 1](#loc=477417)

locations.title: 14 - Caged by a Hungry Guard
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the caged area; access by digging near the entrance point. Be quick, as a lava Munchoid will come out as soon as you enter the cage.

locations.title: 15 - Landfill Fragmentone Recovery
locations.description: **Location:** Bring a single Chip back to the Fragmentone; see the screenshot for its location.

locations.title: 16 - Landfill Fragmentone Restoration
locations.description: **Location:** Bring both remaining Chips to the Fragmentone. You can use Elephant Bananza to clear the lava and safely bring them back.

locations.title: 17 - Nestled with the Debris
locations.description: **Location:** Straight underneath [Lower Pit](#loc=477421), in the middle of a pile of debris.

locations.title: 18 - Cranky's Landfill Rant
locations.description: **Location:** Given by [Cranky Kong](#loc=477425).

locations.title: 19 - Landfill Smashin' Stats
locations.description: **Location:** Given by Fractone after destroying at least 70,000 cubic meters of dirt in the layer.

locations.title: 20 - A Rare Treasure
locations.description: **Location:** At the end of the rocky passageways, behind a brekaable wall.

locations.title: 21 - Battle: Hundred-Harasser Horde
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Landfill Layer Battle Challenge 2](#loc=477430)

locations.title: 22 - Delivery Completed
locations.description: **Location:** [Quick-Service Ice Treats](#loc=477432) - Pull the lever to activate the ice cube machine. Then, destroy the chocolate corks in the ice tunnel to fill the bowl with ice cubes.

locations.title: 23 - Speedy Delivery
locations.description: **Location:** [Quick-Service Ice Treats](#loc=477432) - Complete [22 - Delivery Completed](#loc=477435) in under 60 seconds.

locations.title: 24 - Beneath the Bowl
locations.description: **Location:** [Quick-Service Ice Treats](#loc=477432) - Beside the bowl at the end of the challenge, punch the wall to reveal a hole. Dig through the hole to reveal the gem.

locations.title: 25 - Battle: Explosive Excavation
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Landfill Layer Battle Challenge 3](#loc=477438)

locations.title: 26 - Follow the Crystal Vein
locations.description: **Location:** In the center of the platform; follow the crystal vein, digging on the lower level to access.

locations.description: **Location:** Sold by [Chip Exchange](#loc=477441)

locations.title: Landfill Layer Battle Challenge 1
locations.description:
**Location:** In a hidden cavern beside the main pit. Reveal it by finding a blue creature in the central pit, who will dig straight to the cavern.

**Opponents:** 3x Crockoid

**Reward:** [13 - Battle: Search and Destroy](#loc=477418)

locations.title: Landfill Layer Battle Challenge 2
locations.description:
**Location:** Behind a narrow crack in the tunnel; dig through the wall to access.

**Opponents:** 100x Peekaboopoids

**Reward:** [21 - Battle: Hundred-Harasser Horde](#loc=477431)

locations.title: Landfill Layer Battle Challenge 3
locations.description:
**Location:** In a cavern blocked by boulders; destroy them to access. Costs 600 gold to unlock.

**Opponents:** 3x Crockoid

**Reward:** [25 - Battle: Explosive Excavation](#loc=477439)

locations.title: Shifty Smash
locations.description:
**Location:** In a side cavern, beside [Elephant Bananza: City Smash](#loc=477407).

**Strategy:** Time your descent with the rotating lava. Alternatively, Elephant Kong is extremely efficient in clearing both the dirt and the shifty block itself.

**Reward:** [09 - Shifty Smash: Dig Deep](#loc=477412)
